{{recipe}}

This salad is very easy to make. 

== Ingredients ==
* 1 pickling [[cookbook:cucumber|cucumber]]
* 1 large [[cookbook:tomato|tomato]]
* 1 head [[cookbook:onion|onion]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:vegetable oil|sunflower oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:Salt|salt]] or to taste

== Procedure ==
# [[cookbook:Chop|Chop]] cucumbers and tomatoes into small cubes (approx. ¼ inch on the side).
# Peel and chop the onion.
# Combine all of the above in an appropriately sized bowl.
# Add sunflower oil and mix well.
# Add salt to taste and mix again.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Sunflower oil is usually available at ethnic stores. If not available, it can be substituted for any vegetable oil, although that will change the authentic taste.
* A chopped [[cookbook:Green Onion|green onion]] or a couple can be optionally added to the mix for a "greener" taste.
* The salad should better be all used up at once; the taste starts to deteriorate after a few hours.
